title: Identifying infection stages, infectivity weights, and initial states from incidence
description: For a single staged SIR chain with a common progression rate, a complete noiseless incidence germ in the same physical time and known population uniquely determine the unknown finite stage number, both rates, normalized infectivity weights, and all initial states among strictly positive models with w1=1.
